Joseph Lopes is believed to have played electric steel guitar on one of the earliest known commercial recordings to feature the instrument: “Dreams of Aloha,” recorded by Noi Lane’s Hawaiian Orchestra on February 22, 1933, in New York City. (digital.library.adelaide.edu.au)
Gage Brewer played electric guitar publicly in Wichita, Kansas, in October 1932, but his surviving recording was never commercially released and its exact date is uncertain. (flickr.com)
